ability.desc: Sylas whirls his chains around him, dealing <scaleHealth>@ModifiedPercentHealthDamage@</scaleHealth> (@PercentHealth*100@% Maximum Health %i:scaleHealth%) magic damage to nearby enemies and healing himself for @ModifiedHealAmount@ Health.
ability.name: Battle Blast

ability.desc:
Nasus slams his staff on his target, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage (@ADPercent*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedBonusDamage@) and @ASSlowPercent*100@% Chilling them for @Duration@ seconds.

Chill: reduce Attack Speed
ability.name: Bonk!

ability.desc:
Jinx fires a rocket at her target that explodes on impact, damaging all nearby enemies for @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Stun: cannot move, attack, or cast Abilities
ability.name: Fishbones

ability.desc: Vayne fires a heavy bolt at her target, dealing <scaleAD>@TotalDamage@</scaleAD> true damage (@ADPercent*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedDamage@).
ability.name: Silver Bolt

ability.desc: Riven gains a @ModifiedShield@ Health shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and empowers her next @NumberOfAttacks@ attacks with @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage. If Riven has more Health than her target, she deals @PercentDamageIncrease@% more bonus magic damage.
ability.name: Bunny Blade

ability.desc: Miss Fortune fires @WaveCount@ waves of bullets in her target's direction within channels for @ChannelDuration@ seconds. Enemies take @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage from the first bullet that hits them, and @ModifiedReducedDamage@ magic damage from any other bullets that hit.
ability.name: Bullet Time

ability.desc: Galio dashes towards the nearest enemy, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. He then grants himself and the closest ally a @ModifiedShieldAmount@ Health shield for @Duration@ seconds.
ability.name: Outta My Way!

ability.desc: Sivir throws her pizza at her target, dealing <scaleAD>@ModifiedDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@ADPercent*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD%). It then splits into slices and gets delivered to the @Allies@ nearest allies, healing them for @ModifiedHeal@ Health.
ability.name: Pizza Delivery

ability.desc:
Janna sends a twister towards the largest group of enemies. The twister expands when it reaches its destination, knocking all nearby enemies up in the air, Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds, and dealing @ModifiedDamagePerSec@ magic damage each second for @DamageDuration@ seconds.

Stun: cannot move, attack, or cast Abilities
ability.name: Twister!

ability.desc: Taliyah summons a torrent of spiraling rocks in a line of enemy units, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to all enemies it hits. After a brief delay, the wall explodes, dealing @ModifiedExplosionDamage@ additional magic damage to nearby enemies.
ability.name: Weaver's Wall

ability.desc: Lux sends out a singularity to a random enemy. When it detonates, it reduces the target's Attack Damage by @ADReduction*100@% for @Duration@ seconds, and deals @ModifiedDamage@ to nearby enemies.
ability.name: Lucent Singularity

ability.desc: Nilah whirls her whip-blade, dealing @WhirlDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies while healing herself and allies for @ModifiedHealAmount@ Health over @HealingSeconds@ second. She finishes with a burst that deals @BurstDamage@ magic damage.
ability.name: Apotheosis

ability.desc:
Passive: Kai'Sa's attacks apply Plasma. Her next attack against a target with 2 stacks of Plasma deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and removes the Plasma.

Active: Kai'Sa gains @AttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed for @Duration@ seconds. This bonus stacks!
ability.name: Starcharged

ability.desc: Rell forms a tether between herself and her lowest percent Health ally, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to all enemies between herself and her bound ally. She also grants herself and her bound ally @Resists@% of Rell's current Armor and Magic Resist for @Duration@ seconds.
ability.name: Iron Bond

ability.desc: Ekko dives in, granting himself a @ModifiedShieldAmount@ shield for @Duration@ seconds and taunts nearby enemies. When the shield breaks, he emits a time field, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ to nearby enemies and slowing their attack speed by @ASReduction*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Star Diver

ability.desc:
Syndra grants a @ModifiedShieldAmount@ Health shield to a random champion on your bench, then flings them into the arena inside an orb at her closest enemy. The orb deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to enemies hit.

Traits of champions flung onto the board do not become active, except for Corrupted.
ability.name: Force of Will

ability.desc: Combat start: H4kerr!m picks up the unit in the rider hex and then charges directly forward into the enemy backline.
ability.name: Infiltration

ability.desc: Sett gains a @ModifiedShieldAmount@ Health shield and becomes immune to crowd control for @Duration@ seconds. He charges up while the shield is active; when the shield breaks or expires, he deals <scaleAD>@MinADDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage in a cone to all enemies caught within the blast. The blast damage increases, up to <scaleAD>@MaxADDamage@</scaleAD>, depending on how long Sett was charged up.
ability.name: Mecha SLAM!

ability.desc: Draven hurls 2 axes at his target's direction, which then come back to him. Enemies caught in their path take <scaleAD>@TotalDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@ADpercent*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedDamage@), reduced by @FallOffPercent*100@% for each enemy they have already hit.
ability.name: Whirling Death

ability.desc: Leona locks onto her target and calls down an orbital laser strike. The laser deals @ModifiedMaxHealthPerSec@ true damage per second to the target until the target dies, and @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies.
ability.name: Deus Ex Machina

ability.desc:
Passive: Jax leaps to his target and deals @ModifiedBaseDamage@ bonus magic damage every 3rd attack. The bonus damage increases by @ModifiedStackDamage@ every 3rd attack, and stacks up to @TotalStacks@ times.

Current Damage on hit: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT8_Jax_TotalDamage@
ability.name: Adaptive Strike

ability.desc:
Sejuani throws a cryo grenade at the closest enemy that explodes after a @ExplosionDelay@-second delay. Enemies within a @HexRadius@ hexes are Stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds, and take @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage.

Stun: cannot move, attack, or cast Abilities
ability.name: Cryo Grenade

ability.desc: Ashe gains <scaleAD>@TotalDamage@</scaleAD> Attack Damage (@ADPercent*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedADGain@) for the next @Duration@ seconds.
ability.name: Ranger's Focus

ability.desc: Senna fires a laser beam in the direction of her target, dealing <scaleAD>@TotalDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@ADPercent*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedDamage@) to all enemies in a line.
ability.name: Piercing Darkness

ability.desc: Zed briefly becomes untargetable and teleports behind his target, reducing their Armor by @ArmorShred@ and entering KILL MODE for @Duration@ seconds. In KILL MODE, Attacks deal @ModifiedAutoAttackBonus@ bonus physical damage and every 3rd attack deals @ModifiedPhysicalDamage@ physical damage (@ADAmount*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedAutoAttackBonus@) to all adjacent enemies.
ability.name: Empowered Kill Mode

ability.desc:
Mordekaiser transports the arena into his realm for @RealmDuration@ seconds. He @MRShred*100@% Shreds ALL enemies, then slams a building onto the arena that deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to enemies hit.

Shred: reduce Magic Resist
ability.name: Skylines

ability.desc: Annie blasts a cone of fire, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to enemies in front of her, then creates a @ModifiedShield@ Health shield on herself for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Burst Shield

ability.desc: Fiora lunges at her enemy, dealing <scaleAD>@ModifiedDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@PercentAttackDamage@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD%) to all enemies hit. For the next @BuffDuration@ seconds, she takes @DamageReductionPercent@% less damage and her attacks restore @ModifiedHeal@ Health.
ability.name: En Garde!

ability.desc: Alistar slams the ground underneath his target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and knocking them up for @StunDuration@ seconds. He then roars, healing himself and the lowest health ally champion for <scaleHealth>@TotalHealing@</scaleHealth> (@MaxHealthPercent*100@% Maximum Health %i:scaleHealth%)
ability.name: Pulverize

ability.desc: Place Aphelios on the board to choose his Ability.
ability.name: Weapons of the Faithful

ability.desc: Viego becomes unstoppable, leaping to the largest cluster of nearby enemies and slamming his sword down on the enemy with the lowest Health, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to the primary target and @ModifiedAOEDamage@ magic damage to enemies nearby. If Viego kills an enemy, he casts again but deals @DamageFalloffPercent*100@% less damage.
ability.name: Heartbreaker

ability.desc: Kayle's next @AttackCount@ attacks deal <scaleAD>@ModifiedPercentDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@PercentAttackDamage*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD%) to her target, and @ModifiedBonusDamage@ magic damage to enemies within 1 hex of the target.
ability.name: Starfire Spellblade

ability.desc:
Vi grants herself a @ModifiedShieldAmount@ Health shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then she deals @TotalDamage@ physical damage to nearby enemies (@ADPercent*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD%) and @ArmorShredPercent*100@% Sunders them for @ArmorShredDuration@ seconds.

Sunder: reduce Armor
ability.name: Blast Shield

ability.desc: Samira rapidly fires bullets that deal a total of <scaleAD>@TotalDamage@</scaleAD> physical damage (@DamagePercent*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedBonusDamage@). Bullets ricochet to nearby enemies for @ReducedDamagePercent*100@% less damage.
ability.name: Flair

ability.desc:
Sona fires @NumSignals@ beams that cycle between 3 phases:

1: Deal @ModifiedQDamage@ magic damage to the nearest enemies
2: Heal the lowest Health allies for @ModifiedWHeal@ Health
3: Deal @ModifiedEDamage@ magic damage to the nearest enemies and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds

Stun: cannot move, attack, or cast Abilities
ability.name: Crescendo Sequence

ability.desc: Lulu fires a magic bolt at her target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit and @SecondaryModifiedDamage@ to other enemies behind.
ability.name: Glitterlance

ability.desc: Zoe launches a bubble at the nearest non-infected enemy, infecting them with a virus that deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Infected enemies take @PercentDamageIncrease*100@% more damage.
ability.name: Trouble Bubble

ability.desc:
Passive: Nunu and Willump roll a ball around the arena towards the furthest enemy. The ball deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to all enemies it passes through. When they reach their target, they will find a new destination. Nunu and Willump gain @ManaPerSecond@ Mana per second.

Active: Nunu and Willump grow the ball, increasing their movement speed, the size of the ball, and the amount of damage by @IncreasedDamagePercent*100@%.
ability.name: Biggest Roboball Ever!

ability.desc: Blitzcrank creates an empowered field around himself, reducing all damage taken by <scaleAP>@ModifiedDR@</scaleAP> for @Duration@ seconds.
ability.name: Static Defenses

ability.desc:
Camille sweeps with her leg, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage (@PercentAD*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedBonusDamage@) and Disarming enemies hit for @DisarmDuration@ seconds.

Disarm: target cannot move or attack
ability.name: Tactical Sweep

ability.desc:
Gangplank fires a flaming bullet at his target, which deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and @HealingReductionPct@% Wounds the enemy for @Duration@ seconds.

Wound: reduces healing received
ability.name: Trial by Fire

ability.desc:
Lee Sin dashes towards a nearby ally, shielding them and himself for @ModifiedShieldAmount@ Health for @Duration@ seconds. He then dashes back and deals @TotalDamage@ physical damage (@ADPercent@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD%) to his target.

If there are no nearby allies, he gains a @DoubledShieldAmount@ Health shield instead.
ability.name: Safeguard

ability.desc: Malphite slams the ground, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and granting himself @ArmorAmount@ Armor for @Duration@ seconds.
ability.name: Ground Slam

ability.desc:
Vel'koz Stuns the enemy champion that has dealt the most damage this round for @FreezeDuration@ seconds and deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to them. An enemy cannot be frozen again for @VelkozICD@ seconds after being frozen.

Stun: cannot move, attack, or cast Abilities
ability.name: Frozen Tomb

ability.desc:
Passive: +@PassiveMR@ Magic Resist

Active: Cho'gath breathes a cosmic beam in a forward arc that deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage (@MRPercent*100@% Magic Resist %i:scaleMR% + @ModifiedBonusDamage@) and @ManaReave@% Mana Reaves the target.

Mana Reave: increase maximum Mana until the next cast
ability.name: Cosmic Bellow

ability.desc:
Aurelion Sol calls down @NumMeteors@ meteors on random enemies. Meteors deal @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage, then @PercentBurn@% Burn and @HealingReduction@% Wound enemies for @Duration@ seconds.

Burn: deals some of the target's maximum Health as true damage
Wound: reduces healing received
ability.name: Meteor Shower

ability.desc:
Passive: +@PassiveArmor@ Armor

Active: Rammus powers himself up and leaps to the largest group of nearby enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage (@PercentArmor*100@% Armor %i:scaleArmor% + @ModifiedBonusDamage@), knocking them up for @StunDuration@ seconds, and reducing their Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% by @ADreduction@% for @ADReductionDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Sand Slam

ability.desc:
Bel'Veth dashes around her target and unleashes a flurry of @NumAttacks@ attacks (@ASMult*100@% of her Attacks per second), each dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage (@ADMult*100@% Attack Damage %i:scaleAD% + @ModifiedBonusDamage@).

Each time this is cast, Bel'Veth gains @ASPerCast@% bonus Attack Speed for the rest of combat.
ability.name: Endless Banquet

ability.desc:
Passive: Upon dying, split into @ZacBlobCount@ smaller Zac Blobs with @HealthPercent*100@% of Zac's maximum Health that taunt nearby enemies.

Active: Zac bounces into the air and slams down, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ + @HPPercentDamage*100@% of his current Health as magic damage to nearby enemies. Then he heals @HPPercentHeal*100@% of his missing Health.
ability.name: Symbiotic Split

ability.desc:
Passive: Urgot's claw fires @AttacksPerSecond@ attacks per second, each dealing @DamagePerShot@ (@ADModified@+@ASModified@) physical damage.

Active: Urgot summons a gigantic wave behind his enemies that deals @MaxHPPercent*100@% of their maximum Health as magic damage. The wave knocks enemies forward 1 hex, Stuns them for @StunDuration@ seconds, and has a @ModifiedTreasureChance@ chance to dredge up treasure (gold and loot).

Stun: cannot move, attack, or cast Abilities
ability.name: Undertow

ability.desc: Fiddlesticks teleports into the largest cluster of enemies and fears them for @StunDuration@ seconds. For the next @UltDuration@ seconds, Fiddlesticks drains the life from nearby enemies dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage per second and healing for @DrainPercent@% of the damage dealt.
ability.name: Dark Harvest

ability.desc:
Passive: Urgot focuses fire on the nearest enemy, raining blasts into them that deal physical damage.

Active: Urgot summons 2 gigantic waves from above and below that converge towards the center of the board and each deal @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. The force of the wave knocks back enemies 1 hex and stuns them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Undertow

ability.desc: Yuumi fires a curved missile at the furthest target in her attack range, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to the first unit hit.
ability.name: Prowling Projectile

ability.desc: Yasuo fires a whirlwind at his target dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and knocking up units hit for @KnockupDuration@ seconds. If the current position isn't ideal, he will dash up to 1 hex in order to find more units in a line.
ability.name: Steel Tempest

ability.desc:
Passive: Aurelion Sol's attacks @PercentBurn@% Burn his target and a random ally.

Active: Aurelion Sol calls down @NumMeteors@ meteors on random enemies. Meteors deal @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage, then @PercentBurn@% Burn and @HealingReduction@% Wound enemies for @Duration@ seconds.

Burn: deals some of the target's maximum Health as true damage
Wound: reduces healing received
ability.name: Meteor Shower

ability.desc: Poppy throws her buckler at the farthest enemy, dealing @PercentArmorDamage*100@% of her Armor as magic damage. (total: @TotalDamage@) The buckler then bounces back, granting Poppy a shield that blocks @ModifiedShield@ damage.
ability.name: Buckler Toss

ability.desc:
Passive: Whenever Zac loses @BlobHPPercentThreshold@% of his maximum Health, he spawns a Blob with @HealthPercent*100@% of his maximum Health.

Active: Zac bounces into the air and slams back down, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ + @HPPercentDamage*100@% of his current Health as magic damage to nearby enemies and healing himself for @HPPercentHeal*100@% of his missing Health.
ability.name: Symbiotic Split

ability.desc: Talon jumps to the furthest unit from the center of the board and stabs them for @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. If this kills them, Talon heals for @HealAmount@ Health.
ability.name: OX-ian Diplomacy

ability.desc: Renekton empowers himself for @Duration@ seconds, gaining @ModifiedBonusHealth@ maximum Health, and causing his attacks to deal <scaleHealth>@TotalDamage@</scaleHealth> (@MaximumHealthPercent*100@% Maximum Health %i:scaleHealth%) as bonus magic damage.
ability.name: Dominus

ability.desc: Wukong spins his staff around him, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies. He gains @DefenseGain@ Armor and Magic Resist for each enemy hit for @Duration@ seconds.
ability.name: Stone Skin

ability.desc:
Ezreal fires an orb of physical sabotage at his target, @ASReduce@% Chilling them for @Duration@ seconds. Then he fires another shot, which deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Chill: reduce Attack Speed
ability.name: Sabotage

ability.desc: Soraka launches a star at her target, which deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and heals Soraka for @PercentMaxHP*100@% of her maximum Health. Every @EmpoweredCast@ casts, she launches @EmpoweredStars@ stars at each of the nearest enemies.
ability.name: Starcall

ability.desc: LeBlanc fires @SigilAmt@ sigils at her target, each dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage. If the target dies, she completes casting the remaining sigils at the nearest enemy but adds @SigilOnKill@ more sigil.
ability.name: Sigil of Malice

ability.desc:
Drag this Archive to the Shop to open an Armory full of Augments! You will have 30 seconds to choose. Depending on when the Archive is sold, the shop will have a higher tier of Augments available.

Stage 1-2: Tier 1 (Silver)

Stage 3: Tier 2 (Gold)

Stage 4+: Tier 3 (Prismatic)
ability.name: Archive Of Augments

ability.desc: The Training Dummy cannot move or attack. It is also dressed like a devilishly handsome Yordle.
ability.name: On Duty!

ability.desc: This chest stores all of the accumulated loot you've collected. Win a combat against a player to open it!
ability.name: Mercenary Chest

ability.desc: This egg will soon hatch into tons of loot! Victorious player combats accelerate the hatch timer by an additional turn.
ability.name: Hatching

traits.desc:
If there is a Civilian alive, your team is inspired to protect them by gaining Mana every @Seconds@ seconds.

(@MinUnits@) +@ManaRegen@ Mana
traits.name: Civilian

traits.desc:
A.D.M.I.N. programs a custom configuration per player each game.

(@MinUnits@) [Initialize ADMIN cause and effect]
(@MinUnits@) [Add another effect to the program]. Boost all tiers by @4tooltip@%
(@MinUnits@) Boost previous tiers by @6Tooltip@%
traits.name: A.D.M.I.N.

traits.desc:
Anima Squad members pose after champion kills, increasing their fame. Each point of fame grants @HealthPerStack@ permanent Health to each Anima Squad member.

They also gain:
(@MinUnits@) @InitialAD@% Attack Damage and @InitialAP@ Ability Power

Total fame: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT8_AnimaFameStacks@
Bonus Health: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT8_AnimaFameHP@
traits.name: Anima Squad

traits.desc:
When a LaserCorp agent attacks or is hit by an attack, their combat drone deals magic damage to the agent's target (@ICD@ second cooldown). When a LaserCorp agent dies, their drone is reassigned to the nearest living agent.

Drone lasers deal:
(@MinUnits@) @MagicDamage@ magic damage
(@MinUnits@) @MagicDamage@ magic damage
(@MinUnits@) @MagicDamage@ magic damage
(@MinUnits@) @MagicDamage@ magic damage, and each agent gets a 2nd drone

Drone damage last round: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT8_Lasercorps_DamageTRAKey@ magic damage
traits.name: LaserCorps

traits.desc:
Brawlers gain additional maximum Health.

(@MinUnits@) +@BonusPercentHealth*100@% maximum Health
traits.name: Brawler

traits.desc:
Use the Mecha selector item to choose a PRIME.

Combat start: the PRIME combines with the 2 nearest Mecha, absorbing @HealthPercent@% of their Base Health.

(@MinUnits@) The PRIME gains @APAmount@ Ability Power and @ADPercent@% Attack Damage
(@MinUnits@) All Mechas gain @APAmount@ Ability Power and @ADPercent@% Attack Damage; the PRIME gains double this amount
traits.name: Mecha:PRIME

traits.desc: Threats do not have a Trait bonus, but instead have powerful Abilities and increased base stats.
traits.name: Threat

traits.desc:
Your team heals a percentage of their maximum Health every @Seconds@ seconds, and Mascots heal double the amount.

When Mascots die, they retreat to the sidelines to cheer on your team. Your team's healing increases by @HealthRegenPerMascot@% for each cheering Mascot.

(@MinUnits@) @BaseHealthRegen@% healing
traits.name: Mascot

traits.desc: Depending on the weather, The Forecaster grants a different bonus to adjacent allies. The weather changes every game.
traits.name: Forecaster

traits.desc:
This Trait is active only when you have exactly 1 or 4 unique Aces.

(@MinUnits@) Execute enemies under @ExecuteThreshhold@% Health
traits.name: Ace

traits.desc:
Innate: Increased movement speed.

Duelists' attacks grant bonus Attack Speed, up to @MaxStacks@ stacks.

(@MinUnits@) +@ASPerStack@% Attack Speed per stack
traits.name: Duelist

traits.desc:
Ox Force units gain a range of Attack Speed that ramps as they lose Health. Once per combat, when they would drop below one health, they instead go to one health and become immune to damage for @Seconds@ second.

(@MinUnits@) @MinAttackSpeed@% - @MaxAttackSpeed@% Attack Speed
traits.name: Ox Force

traits.desc: (@MinUnits@) When deploying the Arsenal champion, players may choose which weapon he will equip.
traits.name: Arsenal

traits.desc:
Your team gains bonus Magic Resist, and Aegis units gain more.

(@MinUnits@) +@MagicResist@ Magic Resist, +@AegisMagicResist@ for Aegis
traits.name: Aegis

traits.desc:
The Underground must sneak through the sewers after each player combat and crack @RoundCount@ locks to open a vault. When the vault opens, you may choose to take the loot now, or attempt another heist for even better rewards.

(@MinUnits@) @WinProgress@ locks per win, @LossProgress@ per loss

Current Heist Level: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT8_Underground_CurrentStage@
traits.name: Underground

traits.desc:
Star Guardians gain more Mana in combat.

(@MinUnits@) @AdditionalManaPercentage@% Mana
traits.name: Star Guardian

traits.desc:
(@MinUnits@) Once per combat at @HealthThreshold@% Health, Pranksters spawn a target dummy, move to a safe location, and restore @HealthRegen@ Health.
(@MinUnits@) And, Prankster dummies stun the enemy that killed them for @StunDuration@ seconds.
traits.name: Prankster

traits.desc:
When Heart units cast their Ability, your team gains stacking Ability Power for the rest of combat.

(@MinUnits@) +@APPerCast@ Ability Power
traits.name: Heart

traits.desc:
(@MinUnits@) Combat start: Lie dormant while absorbing the souls of allies that die. Gain @BonusAP@ Ability Power for each soul.

Once per combat at @HealthThreshold@% Health (or when your team has died), come alive and fight.
traits.name: Corrupted

traits.desc:
(@MinUnits@) Combat start: Strike a pose that grants your team @BaseBonusDamage@% bonus damage, which increases by @BonusDamagePer3Star@% for every 3-star champion on your team.

Bonus damage: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT8_Supers_TotalBonusDamage@%
traits.name: Supers

traits.desc:
Renegade units deal bonus damage, and the last one standing deals more.

(@MinUnits@) @BasePercentBonusDamage@% bonus damage, extra @AdditionalBonusDamage@% for last alive
traits.name: Renegade

traits.desc:
Every @RefreshSeconds@ seconds, Spellslinger's next attack instead fires a magic orb at a random target, which explodes for @MagicDamage@% Ability Power as magic damage.

Spellslingers gain:
(@MinUnits@) +@AP@ Ability Power
(@MinUnits@) +@AP@ Ability Power
(@MinUnits@) +@AP@ Ability Power
(@MinUnits@) +@AP@ Ability Power, and orbs deal @MagicDamage@% Ability Power
traits.name: Spellslinger

traits.desc:
Innate: Gain @BonusRange@ hex Attack Range.

If there is an enemy nearby, Recon units will dash to safety before casting their Ability.

(@MinUnits@) +@CritChanceAmpPercent@% Crit Chance
(@MinUnits@) +@CritChanceAmpPercent@% Crit Chance
(@MinUnits@) +@CritChanceAmpPercent@% Crit Chance and Recon Abilities can critically strike
traits.name: Recon

traits.desc:
Combat start: Sureshots gain bonus Attack Damage now, and every @Frequency@ seconds.

(@MinUnits@) +@BonusAD*100@% Attack Damage
traits.name: Sureshot

traits.desc:
Innate: Taunt nearby enemies after the start of combat.

Your team gains bonus Armor, and Defenders gain more.

(@MinUnits@) +@BonusArmor@ Armor, +@DefenderBonusArmor@ for Defenders

Taunt: enemies that are able and in range must attack the taunter
traits.name: Defender

traits.desc:
Each round, Gadgeteens create random modified weapons with powerful effects that fall apart after one round. Gadgeteens also gain Damage and Damage Reduction for each item equipped to them.

(@MinUnits@) Create @ItemsToMake@ item, @Itembuff@% per item.
(@MinUnits@) Create @ItemsToMake@ items, @Itembuff@% per item.
traits.name: Gadgeteen

traits.desc:
Hackers gain Omnivamp and summon a H4ckerr!m. Any unit placed in the rider hex will be sent to the enemy backline and is untargetable for the first @SecondsUntargetable@ seconds of combat.

(@MinUnits@) @Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp

Omnivamp: heal for some of damage dealt
traits.name: Hacker
